There’s a field not far from here I love in the web that God has spun.

scene afterthatyasuithing6
: Yasu, just what exactly did you say to Sana? The poor girl seemed utterly mortified.
: Sana?
: Yes. Sana. The girl you were just talking to. With black hair and only one eye.
scene afterthatyasuithing7
: Hmm...
: I don’t really remember.
: Everything seems a little fuzzy.
: Did I make another mistake?
: I doubt it would be a mistake, but there is no way of knowing for sure without someone telling me what was discussed...
: Regardless, please be on your very best behavior going forward. Your contest is about to begin and, while I will be with you for the first half of it, the second lies entirely in your hands.
scene afterthatyasuithing8
: Contest?
: Lord, help me.
scene afterthatyasuithing9
: He-
: Not yours, Yasu. Anything but yours.
scene afterthatyasuithing10
: Hmph! Mean Touka.
: Mean Touka, indeed. Now, come with me so we can review proper self-defense techniques and safety precautions before your departure.
scene afterthatyasuithing11
: Is this really how the entire weekend is going to be?
: Would’ve been like this even earlier if you hadn’t fuckin’ wandered off to god knows where. Sides, it ain’t like we’re enjoyin’ this shit either. I’m bored as fuck.
: I don’t particularly mind. I have actually been considering a second career in security since stand-up comedy doesn’t seem like it will be panning out for me anytime soon.
: Good luck gettin’ hired. One thing I learned from goin’ around lookin’ for work is that nobody in this fuckin’ town is takin’ on any new employees.
scene afterthatyasuithing12
: You’re still looking?
: Course I’m still lookin’. Fuck else am I gonna do when I’m not watchin’ Chinami or dealin’ with your bullshit?
: Just fuckin’ sucks cause I’ve had to go to like ten different interviews now and all of ‘em have just said “they’ll call me.” Fucking when? Cause I’m startin’ to think they ain’t callin’ at all.
scene afterthatyasuithing13
: Perhaps you are not making a strong enough first impression?
: Or perhaps it’s the exact opposite...

: Well, what kinda first impressions are these places lookin’ for? Cause I’ve been as nice and polite as I fuckin’ can but it’s like they all stop givin’ a shit the second they look at my application thing.
: It varies business to business. But I believe entering an interview with some sort of special skill would leave a strong first impression regardless of what company you are applying to.
: Skill? What kinda skill? I ain’t got any skills.
: I have heard that juggling is not hard to grasp the basics of. Learning to do that might make for a more memorable interview if you hit them with it early.
: Yeah, great idea. I’ll get right on that.
: Yumi...just out of curiosity, what are you writing down for your name on all of your job applications?
scene afterthatyasuithing14
: Huh? What kinda fuckin’ question is that? I’m writin’ my name obviously. Don’t tell me that spot’s been a fuckin’ trick question this whole time?
: And you’re absolutely sure you’ve been polite in all of your interviews?
: Polite as I fuckin’ can be.
: I can’t tell if that’s a yes or no.
: Just get to the fuckin’ point, asshole. I ain’t got all night.
: Yes you do. We are on guard duty.
: Fuck off, Noodle Girl. I ain’t talkin’ to you.
: Yumi, isn’t your family name directly tied to the Yakuza?
scene afterthatyasuithing15
: Yeah. So?
: So...if you are doing everything else correctly, it’s possible your interviewers just take one look at your name and pass on you.
: Cause of the Yakuza shit? Why? Figured that’d be, like...a selling point or somethin’. Like hey, free protection or whatever.
: This might come as a surprise to you, but there are a lot of people out there who just don’t really want to be linked to any sort of organized crime.
scene afterthatyasuithing16
: The fuck am I supposed to do then?! I can’t just change my fuckin’ name!
: I will allow you to use mine. Yumi Arakawa has a nice ring to it.
: No it fucking doesn’t!
: Arakawa Ramen does not sound like an effective name for a business. If we are ever wed, you will be taking my name.
scene afterthatyasuithing17
: The fuck is this about getting “wed?!” Don’t tell me this dude’s porkin’ you too?!
: Of course not. The only person who porks me is the meat delivery driver every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.
: Not what that means, Tsuneyo.
: As if you would know. I have been being porked ever since I was a child.
: In fact, I would not be surprised if I had been porked by hundreds by now.
scene afterthatyasuithing18
: God, I can’t wait until this stupid fucking contest is over...
: It sounds to me like someone needs to get porked.
: Just fuckin’ kill me instead, please.
: Alright, alright! Who’s ready to get this show on the road?!
scene afterthatyasuithing19
: We’ve got a whopping two contests lined up for you guys tonight! And the first one begins in just a few minutes!
scene afterthatyasuithing20
: Also, as a favor to Imani, we’ve decided to get both of the borderline-illegal competitions out of the way back-to-back so she’ll be able to rest all day tomorrow!
: Cause if caring about us wasn’t already enough, sharing a room with Sensei tonight is sure to take a heck of a lot out of her!
: Be gentle, Senpai. I’m delicate.
: Step back, Miss Imai. No one approaches the target- not even another teacher.
: Don’t worry, Imani. I’ll take good care of you.
: Ew, ew, ew! Everyone shut the fuck up!
scene afterthatyasuithing21

: The night will begin with the ceremonial escorting of the hostages. And once that is taken care of, the main event shall commence and we’ll all get to watch Chika be sexy! Also, I’ll be there too I guess.
: Woo! Go Uta! You’re hotter anyway!
scene afterthatyasuithing22
: Hey! That’s totally not true but thank you for lying to me! And thank you for volunteering to handle the color commentary as well!
: Looking forward to it!
: M-Me too! But...I think there’s something I’m not understanding. Kirin says...you two will be...modeling swimsuits for...Sensei?
: Isn’t...Isn’t that a little...inappropriate?
: Yes! Look forward to it in just a short while!
scene afterthatyasuithing23
: But for now, let’s go over how this is going to work one more time!
: As you may have noticed, our contestants are currently being blindfolded. These blindfolds are not to be removed until Ayane and Yasu are deep within the jungles of Kumon-mi beach!
: Once they are, their escort will remove their blindfold and make their way back to the rest of us! If they don’t get lost as well, that is. That forest is pretty dense.
: Anyway, once either Yasu or Ayane makes it back, the contest will end and the girl who returned will earn a point for her team!
: What happens if neither of ‘em make it back?
: Then we’ll all be in a lot of trouble and the Dorm Wars will be the least of our worries!
: The contest begins in ten minutes! Say your goodbyes now, as this may very well be your final chance!
: Are you properly blinded, Ayane? Any last minute adjustments that need...adjusting?
: Are we really just...being left in the woods? Isn’t that a little too serious for a Dorm Wars contest?
scene afterthatyasuithing24
: I would trade places with you if I could. My druidic powers would make moving through the forest significantly easier than my dreaded cooking contest will be tomorrow.
: If only I could wildshape into a nice dinner. Then, all of my problems would be but whispers in the trees that you will soon find yourself surrounded by.
: Yeah...that helps a lot, Molly. Thanks.
scene afterthatyasuithing25
: Are you actually worried, Lidearel? You’re typically the bravest of all of us. Save the Kendo Princess, but I’m not sure if she even understands fear.
: Kind of, yeah. I’m not really in the right headspace to be doing this right now. Nor do I have any idea how I’m even going to do this without my phone.
: We really do depend on technology nowadays, don’t we?
: Honestly...the only thing keeping me comfortable right now is that you’ll be escorting me out there. Because I don’t really want to quit, but if it really comes down to it-
: I apologize for being the harbinger of unfortunate news, Ayane- but I’m unable to serve as your escort tonight. Which I am slightly thankful for because escort quests are the actual worst.
: What? Then who-
scene afterthatyasuithing26
: Hi! Are you almost ready to go?
: Lidearel has been feared and left her Insignia of the Horde at home. And as a member of the opposing team, I’m hesitant to dispel it for her.
scene afterthatyasuithing27
: Afraid, huh?
: How come?

: You know I’ll be with you for half of it, right? And I’m really banking on you finding your way back so perverts like Molly, Noriko, and everyone else on the second floor don’t have to sleep at my house.
: Is there...maybe someone else who could...
: Nope! I already volunteered and signed our names on the release form so the school isn’t liable if anything happens to us.
: And by us I mostly mean you since I’ll know the way back.
scene afterthatyasuithing28
: Uhh...Sensei?...Maya?...
: Sensei is busy being guarded and Maya is off doing Maya stuff. Probably looking at the stars or something. You know how she is.
: A true astrologian, through and through.
: Hahah! Yup! That’s Maya alright!
: Ami...I...don’t really know if this...is something I want to...go through with...
: You say that like you expect me to hurt you! Hahah!
scene afterthatyasuithing29
: Why would you think that, Ayane? When have I ever done anything to hurt you before? I love you! Even if you’re getting all distant and spending more time with Maya than me lately.
: I talked to her about it and things actually went really well! And I was hoping I’d be able to talk to you while we’re on our walk next.
: Sensei? Please? Come here?
: He can’t hear you.
scene afterthatyasuithing30
: Ah! There’s the whistle! We must be starting!
: Geh! Loudest feckin’ whistle I’ve ever heard. Nearly KO’ed me.
scene afterthatyasuithing31
: Come on! Let’s take our places so I can make it back before the modeling thing and make sure no one is too sexy!
: Heheh...heh...
: Chin up, Lidearel.
: Yasu...gets lost all the time, so...if anything, I’d say your chances are pretty good.
: I don’t like this, Molly. I really don’t like this.
: I’m sure...it’ll all be worth it in the end.
scene black
: And if it’s not, at least you’ll have tried.
scene afterthatyasuithing32
: Alright, boys and girls! Our contestants are blindfolded and ready to go!
scene afterthatyasuithing33
: As a reminder to our escorts, you are absolutely not, under any circumstances, allowed to provide assistance to your partner once they’re dropped off!
: And that includes lending them your phones as theirs have already been locked away.
: Well...at least Ayane’s has since Yasu doesn’t have a phone.
: Uta, are you absolutely sure this contest is not going to end horribly? Because I’m hesitant to take Yasu into the middle of the woods as this is...
: Well, to make myself sound like a commoner — really fucking stupid.
scene afterthatyasuithing34
: Woah! Since when does an upstanding lady like you have curse words in her vocabulary book?!
: I just think this is a terrible idea and that we should make these two compete in something else instead.
: I’m with Touka. This isn’t a good idea. If one of us gets lost-
: If one of you gets lost, we’ll come find you. It’s not like Touka and I don’t know where we’re headed. It’s only you and Yasu who won’t know where you are.
: Plus, you’ve already signed the waivers. If you were gonna bail on us, you should have done it earlier.
: Oh, yes. Earlier. When I was unable to find Yasu.
: Hey, not my fault she figured out how to take her leash off.
: The only leash I wear is one that binds me to God. And with His help, I will find my way home.
scene afterthatyasuithing35
: Hah...I suppose it can’t be helped.
: Any last words from the girls of the first floor before you’re marched off to your doom?
: Yes. Where’s Sensei? I have to tell him something.
: Just tell me instead and I’ll deliver your message to him. I’m sure it’s nothing you have to keep secret, right?
: I’d just really appreciate it if I could speak to him alone for-
scene afterthatyasuithing36
: Sensei! Ayane wants to see you before she gets lost in the woods! Come on over and give her a kiss goodbye!
: Thank you, Uta. Thank you.
: I’m-
: Nuh-uh. You ain’t goin’ anywhere. Not until I can get eyes on Pinkie.
: Maya is not currently present either. And I am unwilling to let you leave your designated standing spot until she reappears.
: Ayane, just yell it to me. I can’t come over there.
: Uhh...Are you sure?
scene afterthatyasuithing37
: Are you sure, Ayane?
: The suspense is killing me. What will she say?! How will he respond?!
scene afterthatyasuithing38
: I love you!
scene afterthatyasuithing39
: Gah! How anticlimactic! It was only the same thing we’ve heard her say a million times before!
scene clearnightsky
: Anyway! Now that our goodbyes and final words are out of the way...escorts! Take your gals to the middle of nowhere and do what ya please with ‘em!
: Just don’t make it super handsy since we had a clause about that on the waiver thing in...uhh...sub...section...I don’t know. Ask Makoto whenever she gets back.
: But for now...get the heck out of here! Go, go, go!
